name: Remove an install someone copied by hand
covers: A folder copied outside NetDeploy showing up as an install, and Skip this step for what it never had

steps.say: Copy main's folder to a new one called spare, outside NetDeploy, as someone might on a server
Click Refresh above the folder list, so NetDeploy looks at the folder again

hover.text: No Windows service runs from this install

steps.say: spare shows up as an install, though NetDeploy didn't make it. The question mark means no service runs from it

steps.note: Only the last step, deleting the folder, applies to a copy: it never had a service, a task or a database.

steps.checkpoint: spare is gone, and main is untouched
look: spare showed in the folder list with v1.1.0 and a question mark.
Every removal step for something spare never had was skipped, and only its folder was deleted.
The Log tab lists each step that was skipped.
